chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about urine that affects a garment, so he said: "Wash it twice."

key_terms.اغْسِلْهُ: wash it, the command to cleanse the affected item
key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by impurity
key_terms.الْبَوْلِ: urine, the impurity discussed in the ruling
key_terms.عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ: peace be upon them, honorific for the Imamayn referred to in the chain
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice, specifying the number of washings required

ai.seo_question: How should a garment be purified if urine gets on it according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding purification of clothing contaminated by urine. It instructs that the affected garment should be washed twice, indicating the method of removing this najasah.
